evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28765 to 15 ppm, then it held at about 5-7 ppm.
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint to within 1 °C.
Brief overshoot to 760.8 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 750.0 °C.
Power stayed steady at about 45% during growth, down from about 84% at the end of the ramp, as expected once heating stops.
Pressure stable at about 3.02-3.06 Torr with Ar at 100 sccm.

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet. No reference ranges from normal runs were given, so readings were checked against setpoints only.
